title: SirGabes' Techlite & Vanilla+
description: A Tech-lite Modpack based on the Create Mod but also providing a vanilla+ experience using QoL mods & Special FX mods that provide a slightly different vanilla experience.
body:
## SirGabes' Techlite & Vanilla+
I try to maintain this mod to be as lite as possible and to prevent mod bloat. The modpack is heavily geared around Create 6.0 Post Production and some of its add-ons, but it isn't entirely enforced on players who'd want to do traditional Minecraft sandbox, but I've included End Remastered, so there is some form of progressive playthrough.

### For anyone interested to see the modlist below: 
**Main Mods:**
- Comforts, QoL to sleep?
- Create
- Create: Copycats+, Industrial decoration
- Create: Crafts and Addition, for electricity age stuff
- Create: Diesel Generators
- Create: Enchantment Industry
- Create: Slice & Dice
- End Remastered, vanilla+ progression to final End Boss
- Farmer's Delight, Food/Cooking Overhaul to Minecraft
- Handcrafted, Supplementaries, Amendments, QoL to building
- Immersive Aircraft and Machinery, QoL to transportation & mining
- Sophisticated Backpacks, for more obtainable inventory space
- Tempad, futuristic teleportation device
- Tectonic & Terralith, World Gen Overhaul
- Vanilla Backport: Chase the Skies, the Garden Awakens
- Trek, vanilla+ structures
- Yungs, vanilla+ structures

**VFX & Sounds:**
- Ambient Sounds
- Continuity
- Dynamic Crosshair
- Particle Interactions
- Particle Rain
- Particular Reforged
- Pick-Up Notifiers
- Simple Voice Chat
- Sound Physics Remastered
- Sounds
- Subtle Effects
- Visuality
- Wavey Capes

**Shaders & Resourcepacks (by order in Game):**
- Continuity (Resourcepacks from the Continuity mod)
- Detailed Animations
- Fresh Animations
- Visual Vibrance as the main shader
###
> _This modpack is for my Discord community, but anyone can play this modpack if they choose to do so._
